summary: Copy a bounded portion without removing the original items.
documentation: slice creates a shallow array copy from start up to, but not including, end. Missing end means the array length; negative indices count backward from the end.
inputs: An array and optional start/end indices.
returns: A new array containing the selected elements.
caution: Nested objects remain shared references. slice copies; splice mutates the original array.
scenarios: Show the first few bookings in a dashboard preview.
Split an already sorted delivery list into pages.
Keep a copy of the most recent log entries.
title: Preview three bookings
problem: Return the first three items of the input array in their existing order. For fewer than three items, return all of them.
goal: Use Array.slice() or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
